IF bPT101C_Health THEN iPT101_HealthyCount := iPT101_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iPT101_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) OR
       ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) OR
          ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iPT101_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Graceful Degradation to 1oo2 Average *)
    bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bPT101A_Health THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar + rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bPT101B_Health THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar + rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar + rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Critical Loss of Pressure Redundancy: Fail-Safe Default *)
    bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 3: TMR 2oo3 VOTING LOGIC - TURBINE ROTATIONAL SPEED (ST501A/B/C)                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rST501_Dev_AB := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm);
rST501_Dev_BC := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm);
rST501_Dev_CA := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm);

bST501A_Health := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm <= 4000.0) AND
                  ((rST501_Dev_AB <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM) OR (rST501_Dev_CA <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM));

bST501B_Health := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm <= 4000.0) AND
                  ((rST501_Dev_AB <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM) OR (rST501_Dev_BC <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM));

bST501C_Health := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm <= 4000.0) AND
                  ((rST501_Dev_BC <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM) OR (rST501_Dev_CA <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM));

iST501_HealthyCount := 0;
IF bST501A_Health THEN iST501_HealthyCount := iST501_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bST501B_Health THEN iST501_HealthyCount := iST501_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bST501C_Health THEN iST501_HealthyCount := iST501_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iST501_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) OR
       ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm;
    ELSIF ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) OR
          ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iST501_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bST501A_Health THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm + rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bST501B_Health THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm + rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm + rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 4: FIRST-ORDER SENSOR FILTERING & TRANSIENT RATE CALCULATION                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rFilt_DrawPressure_bar := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS * rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar) + 
                          ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS) * rFilt_DrawPressure_bar);

rFilt_FeedPressure_bar := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS * rPressure_FeedInlet_PT102_bar) + 
                          ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS) * rFilt_FeedPressure_bar);

rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS * rPressure_TurbineInlet_PT103_bar) + 
                                  ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS) * rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar);

rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW * rFlow_FeedInlet_FT201_m3h) + 
                      ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW) * rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h);

rFilt_DrawFlow_m3h := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW * rFlow_DrawInlet_FT202_m3h) + 
                      ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW) * rFilt_DrawFlow_m3h);

rFilt_TurbineFlow_m3h := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW * rFlow_TurbineOutlet_FT203_m3h) + 
                         ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW) * rFilt_TurbineFlow_m3h);

rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_SPEED * rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm) + 
                          ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_SPEED) * rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm);

(* Hydraulic surge rate: dp/dt = (P[k] - P[k-1]) / Ts *)
rPressureRateOfChange_bar_s := (rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar - rPrev_TurbineInletPressure_bar) / 0.020;
rPrev_TurbineInletPressure_bar := rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 5: PRO THERMODYNAMICS, VAN 'T HOFF EQUATIONS & CONCENTRATION POLARIZATION (CP)       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature conversion to Kelvin [K] *)
rTemp_Kelvin := ((rTemp_FeedWater_TT401_degC + rTemp_DrawWater_TT402_degC) * 0.5) + 273.15;

(* Convert Conductivities [mS/cm] to equivalent NaCl Salinity [g/L] *)
(* Empirical conversion for brackish/seawater: C [g/L] ~= 0.64 * EC [mS/cm] *)
rSalinity_Feed_gL := rConductivity_Feed_AT301_mScm * 0.640;
rSalinity_Draw_gL := rConductivity_Draw_AT302_mScm * 0.645;

(* Prevent unphysical non-positive salinities *)
IF rSalinity_Feed_gL < 0.05 THEN rSalinity_Feed_gL := 0.05; END_IF;
IF rSalinity_Draw_gL < 1.00 THEN rSalinity_Draw_gL := 1.00; END_IF;

(* Thermodynamic Bulk Osmotic Pressures via Van 't Hoff Equation *)
(* pi = i * phi * (C / M_NaCl) * R * T * 1e-5 [bar] *)
rBulkOsmoticPressure_Feed_bar := C_VANTHOFF_I * C_OSMOTIC_COEFF_PHI * 
                                 (rSalinity_Feed_gL / C_NACL_MOLAR_MASS_KG) * 
                                 C_UNIVERSAL_GAS_CONST_R * rTemp_Kelvin * 1.0E-5;

rBulkOsmoticPressure_Draw_bar := C_VANTHOFF_I * C_OSMOTIC_COEFF_PHI * 
                                 (rSalinity_Draw_gL / C_NACL_MOLAR_MASS_KG) * 
                                 C_UNIVERSAL_GAS_CONST_R * rTemp_Kelvin * 1.0E-5;

rOsmoticPressureDiff_bar := rBulkOsmoticPressure_Draw_bar - rBulkOsmoticPressure_Feed_bar;

(* Net Hydraulic Pressure across membrane active layer *)
rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar := rFilt_DrawPressure_bar - rFilt_FeedPressure_bar;
IF rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar < 0.0 THEN rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Solute transport resistivity inside porous support layer K = S / D *)
rSoluteResistivity_K_sm := C_STRUCTURAL_PARAM_S_M / C_NACL_DIFFUSION_D_M2S;

(* Mass transfer coefficient in draw flow channel k [m/s] *)
(* Scaled by cross-flow shear pump speed: k = k0 * (1 + 0.85 * (Pump_pct / 100)) *)
rMassTransferCoeff_k_m_s := 2.85E-5 * (1.0 + (0.85 * (rShearBoosterPumpVFD_Feedback_Pct / 100.0)));

(* Internal (ICP) and External (ECP) Concentration Polarization Factors *)
(* Convert flux Jw from LMH to m/s: 1 LMH = 2.7778e-7 m/s *)
rExpICP := EXP(LIMIT(0.0, (rXhat_Flux_LMH * 2.7778E-7) * (rSoluteResistivity_K_sm * 0.001), 3.5));
rExpECP := EXP(LIMIT(-3.5, -((rXhat_Flux_LMH * 2.7778E-7) / rMassTransferCoeff_k_m_s), 0.0));

(* Coupled Concentration Polarization Effective Driving Osmotic Pressure *)
(* Numerator: pi_draw * exp(-Jw/k) - pi_feed * exp(Jw*K) *)
rNumerator := (rBulkOsmoticPressure_Draw_bar * rExpECP) - (rBulkOsmoticPressure_Feed_bar * rExpICP);
IF rNumerator < 0.0 THEN rNumerator := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Denominator: 1 + (B / Jw) * (exp(Jw*K) - exp(-Jw/k)) *)
IF rXhat_Flux_LMH > 0.5 THEN
    rDenominator := 1.0 + ((C_SALT_PERM_B_LMH / rXhat_Flux_LMH) * (rExpICP - rExpECP));
ELSE
    rDenominator := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF rDenominator < 0.1 THEN rDenominator := 0.1; END_IF;
rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar := rNumerator / rDenominator;

(* Effective Net Driving Force *)
rEffectiveDrivingPressure_bar := rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar - rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar;

(* Water Permeate Flux Jw = A * (delta_pi_eff - delta_P) [LMH] *)
IF rEffectiveDrivingPressure_bar > 0.0 THEN
    rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH := C_WATER_PERM_A_LMH_BAR * rEffectiveDrivingPressure_bar;
ELSE
    rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Total volumetric permeate suction [m3/h] *)
rPermeationFlow_m3h := (rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH * C_MEMBRANE_AREA_TOTAL_M2) * 1.0E-3;

(* Dimensionless Concentration Polarization Severity Index (0.0 to 1.0) *)
(* Defined as 1 - (delta_pi_eff / delta_pi_bulk) *)
IF rOsmoticPressureDiff_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rConcentrationPolarizationIndex := 1.0 - (rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar / rOsmoticPressureDiff_bar);
    rConcentrationPolarizationIndex := LIMIT(0.0, rConcentrationPolarizationIndex, 1.0);
ELSE
    rConcentrationPolarizationIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) optimal transmembrane pressure: DeltaP* = 0.5 * DeltaPi_eff *)
rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar := 0.50 * rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar;
IF rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar > 60.0 THEN
    rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar := 60.0; (* Mechanical limit of membrane module *)
END_IF;

(* Available Hydro-Mechanical Power at Turbine Shaft *)
(* P_hyd = (Q_m3h * DeltaP_bar) / 36 * eta [kW] *)
rNetHydroPower_kW := ((rFilt_TurbineFlow_m3h * (rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar - rPressure_TurbineOutlet_PT104_bar)) / 36.0) * rTurbineEfficiency;
IF rNetHydroPower_kW < 0.0 THEN rNetHydroPower_kW := 0.0; END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 6: DISCRETE KALMAN OBSERVER STATE UPDATE                                             *)
(* x_hat[k+1] = A_d * x_hat[k] + B_d * u[k] + L * (y[k] - C * x_hat[k])                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Compute Innovations (Measurement Residuals) *)
rResid_DeltaP := rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar - rXhat_DeltaP_bar;
rResid_Flux   := rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH  - rXhat_Flux_LMH;
rResid_CP     := rConcentrationPolarizationIndex - rXhat_CP_Index;
rResid_Speed  := rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm - rXhat_Speed_rpm;

(* Update State Estimate Vector *)
rXhat_DeltaP_bar := (A_11 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_12 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_13 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_14 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                    (B_11 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_12 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_13 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                    (L_11 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_12 * rResid_Flux) + (L_13 * rResid_CP) + (L_14 * rResid_Speed);

rXhat_Flux_LMH := (A_21 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_22 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_23 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_24 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                  (B_21 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_22 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_23 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                  (L_21 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_22 * rResid_Flux) + (L_23 * rResid_CP) + (L_24 * rResid_Speed);

rXhat_CP_Index := (A_31 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_32 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_33 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_34 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                  (B_31 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_32 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_33 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                  (L_31 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_32 * rResid_Flux) + (L_33 * rResid_CP) + (L_34 * rResid_Speed);

rXhat_Speed_rpm := (A_41 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_42 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_43 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_44 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                   (B_41 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_42 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_43 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                   (L_41 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_42 * rResid_Flux) + (L_43 * rResid_CP) + (L_44 * rResid_Speed);

(* Bound State Observer variables within physical limits *)
rXhat_DeltaP_bar := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_DeltaP_bar, 75.0);
rXhat_Flux_LMH   := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_Flux_LMH, 50.0);
rXhat_CP_Index   := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_CP_Index, 1.0);
rXhat_Speed_rpm  := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_Speed_rpm, 4500.0);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 7: DYNAMIC CONCENTRATION POLARIZATION SUPPRESSION (SHEAR PULSER)                     *)
(* Periodic turbulent flush or event-triggered flush when CP index > threshold              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tShearCycleTimer(IN := NOT bShearPulseTriggerCondition AND (iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN), PT := C_SHEAR_CYCLE_PERIOD);

IF tShearCycleTimer.Q OR (rXhat_CP_Index >= rCP_Threshold_Severe) THEN
    bShearPulseTriggerCondition := TRUE;
END_IF;

tShearBurstDurationTimer(IN := bShearPulseTriggerCondition, PT := C_SHEAR_BURST_TIME);
IF tShearBurstDurationTimer.Q THEN
    bShearPulseTriggerCondition := FALSE;
END_IF;

bShearPulseActive := bShearPulseTriggerCondition;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECURSIVE OPTIMIZER                                *)
(* Evaluates optimal actuator vector minimizing multi-objective quadratic cost               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF (iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN) OR (iState = STATE_DEGRADED_FAILSOFT_RUN) THEN
    (* 1. Hydro-Turbine Speed & Pressure Error Formulation *)
    rTempCalc := 3000.0 - rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm; (* 3000 rpm grid synchronization reference *)
    
    (* Wicket gate command synthesized from speed error and optimal pressure tracking *)
    rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct := 50.0 + (0.045 * rTempCalc) + 
                                  (1.25 * (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar - rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar));
    
    (* If degraded mode active, cap wicket gate demand to 75% *)
    IF bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 THEN
        rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct := LIMIT(15.0, rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, 75.0);
    ELSE
        rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct := LIMIT(10.0, rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, 95.0);
    END_IF;

    (* 2. Concentration Polarization Suppression Shear Booster Pump *)
    IF bShearPulseActive THEN
        (* Maximum turbulence burst to scrub boundary layer *)
        rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct := 100.0;
    ELSE
        (* Proportional-Integral baseline tracking of CP index *)
        rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct := 40.0 + (C_MPC_Q_CP * (rXhat_CP_Index - rCP_Threshold_Nominal) * 100.0);
        rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct := LIMIT(30.0, rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct, 85.0);
    END_IF;

    (* 3. High-Pressure Bypass Relief Valve *)
    (* Normally closed; opens dynamically to bleed pressure if overpressure or overspeed threatens *)
    IF rFilt_DrawPressure_bar > 58.0 THEN
        rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar - 58.0) * 12.5; (* Fast linear relief *)
    ELSIF rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm > 3150.0 THEN
        rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm - 3150.0) * 0.15;
    ELSE
        rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := LIMIT(0.0, rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct, 100.0);
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 9: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 HIERARCHY)                               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
CASE iState OF

    STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION: (* State 0: Safe De-energized Standby *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 0.0;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0001;

        IF bEnable AND NOT bTripAlarm AND (iPT101_HealthyCount >= 2) AND (iST501_HealthyCount >= 2) THEN
            iState := STATE_PREFLIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS;
        END_IF;

    STATE_PREFLIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS: (* State 10: TMR Sensor Validation & Baseline Water Quality *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0002;

        (* Check adequate salinity gradient between feed and draw streams *)
        IF (rConductivity_Draw_AT302_mScm >= 35.0) AND (rConductivity_Feed_AT301_mScm <= 6.0) AND
           (tStateDuration >= T#3S) THEN
            iState := STATE_MEMBRANE_SLOW_PRIMING;
        ELSIF tStateDuration > T#10S THEN
            (* Diagnostic Timeout - Abort *)
            bAlarm_LowDrawSalinity := (rConductivity_Draw_AT302_mScm < 35.0);
            bAlarm_HighFeedSalinity := (rConductivity_Feed_AT301_mScm > 6.0);
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_MEMBRANE_SLOW_PRIMING: (* State 20: Gentle feed flooding and air de-aeration *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0004;

        (* Ramp feed pump flow gently to displace air bubbles *)
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 35.0;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 25.0;
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to avoid premature pressure spike *)
        rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := 0.0;

        IF (rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h >= 30.0) AND (rFilt_FeedPressure_bar >= 1.2) AND (tStateDuration >= T#15S) THEN
            iState := STATE_DRAW_PRESSURIZATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_DRAW_PRESSURIZATION: (* State 30: Permeation buildup & Isobaric Pressurization *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0008;

        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 60.0;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 45.0;

        (* Gently ramp bypass valve down to build manifold pressure *)
        IF rBypassValve_Internal_Pct > 20.0 THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := rBypassValve_Internal_Pct - (rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct * 2.0);
        END_IF;

        IF (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar >= 25.0) AND (rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH >= 8.0) AND (tStateDuration >= T#20S) THEN
            iState := STATE_TURBINE_RUNUP_SYNCH;
        END_IF;

    STATE_TURBINE_RUNUP_SYNCH: (* State 40: Turbine Acceleration to Grid Synchronous Speed *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0010;

        (* Gradually crack open wicket gate to spin up turbine *)
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct < 35.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := rWicketGate_Internal_Pct + rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct;
        END_IF;

        (* Modulate bypass to maintain constant backpressure while accelerating *)
        IF rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm < 2850.0 THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := LIMIT(5.0, 50.0 - (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm * 0.015), 50.0);
        ELSE
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for grid intertie synchronization breaker *)
        IF bGridSynchronized AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm >= 2950.0) AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm <= 3050.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN;
        END_IF;

    STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN: (* State 50: Closed-Loop Model Predictive Power Extraction *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0020;

        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 110.0;

        (* Smooth rate-of-change governed actuator transfer from MPC targets *)
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct < rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MIN(rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct + rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        ELSE
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MAX(rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        END_IF;

        IF rBypassValve_Internal_Pct < rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := MIN(rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct, rBypassValve_Internal_Pct + (rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct * 3.0));
        ELSE
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := MAX(rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct, rBypassValve_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        END_IF;

        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct;

        (* Intertie trip supervisor *)
        IF NOT bGridSynchronized THEN
            bAlarm_GridLossOnLoad := TRUE;
            iState := STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP;
        ELSIF bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 THEN
            iState := STATE_DEGRADED_FAILSOFT_RUN;
        ELSIF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_COASTDOWN;
        END_IF;

    STATE_DEGRADED_FAILSOFT_RUN: (* State 70: Fault-Tolerant Single Channel Fallback *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bDegradedOperation := TRUE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0040;

        (* Plant operating with single sensor channel; run with derated power limits *)
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 85.0;
        
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct > 65.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct;
        ELSE
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := LIMIT(15.0, rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, 65.0);
        END_IF;

        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_COASTDOWN;
        ELSIF NOT bGridSynchronized THEN
            iState := STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP;
        END_IF;

    STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP: (* State 80: Emergency Water Hammer Relief on Generator Trip *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0080;

        (* Anti-Surge Fast Open on Bypass Valve (absorbs water column momentum) *)
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 100.0;

        (* Controlled Fast Close on Wicket Gate to avoid runaway overspeed *)
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct > 0.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MAX(0.0, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - (C_EMERGENCY_WICKET_CLOSE_RATE * 0.020));
        END_IF;

        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 20.0;
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 20.0;

        IF (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct <= 0.0) AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm < 300.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CONTROLLED_COASTDOWN: (* State 90: Orderly Plant Shutdown *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0100;

        (* Gently bleed pressure by cracking bypass, closing wicket gate *)
        IF rBypassValve_Internal_Pct < 50.0 THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := rBypassValve_Internal_Pct + rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct;
        END_IF;

        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct > 0.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MAX(0.0, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        END_IF;

        IF rShearPump_Internal_Pct > 0.0 THEN
            rShearPump_Internal_Pct := MAX(0.0, rShearPump_Internal_Pct - (rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct * 2.0));
        END_IF;

        IF rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h > 0.0 THEN
            rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := MAX(0.0, rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h - 1.0);
        END_IF;

        IF (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct <= 0.0) AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm <= 100.0) AND (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar <= 2.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP: (* State 99: Master Hardware Lockout *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#8000;

        (* Immediate Fail-Safe Actuator Positions *)
        rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := 0.0;      (* Direct spring return shut *)
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 100.0;   (* Full open depressurization *)
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 0.0;       (* De-energize VFD *)
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 0.0; (* Trip feed pump *)

        IF bResetAlarms AND bEmergencyStop AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm < 50.0) THEN
            bTripAlarm := FALSE;
            bAlarm_EStopTripped := FALSE;
            bAlarm_MembraneOverpressure_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_TurbineOverspeed_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_LowFeedFlow_LL := FALSE;
            bAlarm_BearingTemp_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_TurbineVibration_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_WaterHammerShock := FALSE;
            bAlarm_GridLossOnLoad := FALSE;
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 10: ALARM TRIP SUPERVISION & TIME-QUALIFIED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Membrane Overpressure High-High: 65.0 bar *)
tOverpressureTripTimer(IN := (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar >= 65.0), PT := T#200MS);
IF tOverpressureTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_MembraneOverpressure_HH := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Hydro-Turbine Mechanical Overspeed High-High: 3450 rpm (115% rated) *)
tOverspeedTripTimer(IN := (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm >= 3450.0), PT := T#100MS);
IF tOverspeedTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_TurbineOverspeed_HH := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Loss of Feed Flow / Cavitation Risk: < 15.0 m3/h when running *)
tLowFeedFlowTripTimer(IN := (rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h <= 15.0) AND (iState >= STATE_DRAW_PRESSURIZATION), PT := T#2S);
IF tLowFeedFlowTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_LowFeedFlow_LL := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Turbine Thrust Bearing Metal Temperature: > 85.0 deg C *)
tHighBearingTempTripTimer(IN := (rTurbineBearingTemp_TT502_degC >= 85.0), PT := T#1S);
IF tHighBearingTempTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_BearingTemp_HH := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Radial Shaft Vibration Velocity: > 7.5 mm/s RMS (ISO 10816 Zone D) *)
tHighVibrationTripTimer(IN := (rTurbineVibration_VT503_mms >= 7.5), PT := T#500MS);
IF tHighVibrationTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_TurbineVibration_HH := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Water Hammer Shock Detection: dp/dt > 12.0 bar/s *)
tPressureTransientSurgeTimer(IN := (ABS(rPressureRateOfChange_bar_s) >= 12.0), PT := T#60MS);
IF tPressureTransientSurgeTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_WaterHammerShock := TRUE;
    (* Do not latch trip immediately, but force surge dump state to vent shock wave *)
    IF iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN THEN
        iState := STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Severe Concentration Polarization Saturation Alarm *)
bAlarm_SevereCPSaturation := (rConcentrationPolarizationIndex >= 0.65);

(* Feed Pump Cavitation Risk *)
bAlarm_FeedPumpCavitationRisk := (rFilt_FeedPressure_bar < 0.8) AND (iState >= STATE_MEMBRANE_SLOW_PRIMING);

(* Strobe Heartbeat Bit *)
bAlarm_WatchdogHeartbeat := NOT bAlarm_WatchdogHeartbeat;

(* Construct ISA-18.2 Categorized 32-bit Alarm Word *)
dwAlarmWord.0  := bAlarm_EStopTripped;
dwAlarmWord.1  := bAlarm_MembraneOverpressure_HH;
dwAlarmWord.2  := bAlarm_TurbineOverspeed_HH;
dwAlarmWord.3  := bAlarm_LowFeedFlow_LL;
dwAlarmWord.4  := bAlarm_BearingTemp_HH;
dwAlarmWord.5  := bAlarm_TurbineVibration_HH;
dwAlarmWord.6  := bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy;
dwAlarmWord.7  := bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy;
dwAlarmWord.8  := bAlarm_SevereCPSaturation;
dwAlarmWord.9  := bAlarm_WaterHammerShock;
dwAlarmWord.10 := bAlarm_LowDrawSalinity;
dwAlarmWord.11 := bAlarm_HighFeedSalinity;
dwAlarmWord.12 := bAlarm_GridLossOnLoad;
dwAlarmWord.13 := bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2;
dwAlarmWord.14 := bAlarm_FeedPumpCavitationRisk;
dwAlarmWord.15 := bAlarm_WatchdogHeartbeat;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 11: FINAL OUTPUT CLAMPING & PHYSICAL VALUE ASSIGNMENT                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rTurbineWicketGate_Cmd_Pct      := LIMIT(0.0, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct, 100.0);
rTurbineBypassValve_Cmd_Pct     := LIMIT(0.0, rBypassValve_Internal_Pct, 100.0);
rShearBoosterPump_Speed_Cmd_Pct := LIMIT(0.0, rShearPump_Internal_Pct, 100.0);
rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h   := LIMIT(0.0, rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h, 150.0);

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
